notes.title: Cluppets 1.1 Update
notes.notes:
10 New levels with new Cluppets and a new Boss have been added to the game

Fixed a couple of game breaking Bugs where Cluppets could get stuck in a way what wouldn't allow the level to be completed.

Added many new different Quality Settings Options you can now choose when starting the game.

Some extra qol changes made like being able to skip story sequences ect...
